patch.summary: Chronosphere cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Chronosphere pricing is plan-gated across 2 researched tiers. No free plan confirmed in SoftwareGlimpse research. 14-day trial documented. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.
bullets: Free plan: not confirmed in SG data

blocks.title: Chronosphere plan matrix and who each tier suits
blocks.body: Structure and trial/free flags come from SoftwareGlimpse pricing research. Dollar amounts appear only when verified — never invent list prices.

lines.label: Pilot
lines.description: 14-day trial · Contact sales · Unlocks: incident management, infrastructure monitoring, APM and distributed tracing · Suits: teams that need custom procurement

lines.description: Contact sales · Suits: teams that need custom procurement

blocks.heading: Chronosphere cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Chronosphere against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Scope a time-boxed pilot; 14-day trial documented.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (incident management, infrastructure monitoring, APM and distributed tracing) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Does not outrank Datadog (8.6). Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when SRE teams drowning in Prometheus cardinality who will run a 2–3 week pilot requires a paid unlock you will use weekly
Do not overbuy if this limitation dominates: Does not outrank Datadog (8.6)
Side-by-side cost with Datadog on the same seat count

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: No public list price — do not invent a host or GB floor

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Pilot length is FAQ-typical (2–3 weeks), not a published 14-day self-serve tile

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: Not a Honeycomb-style wide-event specialist as the primary identity

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Not ITSM, git, hosting panel, managed hosting, or cloud PaaS

blocks.title: Cheaper or clearer alternatives to pressure-test
blocks.body: Compare total cost of ownership vs Chronosphere on identical constraints.

blocks.title: Model it-development spend with Chronosphere in mind
blocks.body: Use researched plan structure for Chronosphere alongside category cost modelling.
